The leak is in `put()`. The key is `(job_id, attempt, time.time())`, so every call creates a new entry, and nothing removes entries. The 408k new objects in the snapshot match that: each retry or result adds one permanent entry. The `time.time()` component is why even repeated puts for the same job and attempt never overwrite each other.
